caption:
A tide is not gravity being strong.
It is gravity being uneven.

captions.text: There are two high tides a day.
Only one of them makes any sense.
The Moon passes overhead and the sea rises to meet it. Fine.
But twelve hours later it rises again,
on the side of the planet facing away.
You were probably taught that centrifugal force
Physicists call that one a misconception.
Nothing out there is being pushed.
So the Moon pulls the near ocean hardest.
It pulls the solid Earth a little less.
And the far ocean least of all.
So the planet gets pulled out from under its own water.
It is also why your bath has no tide.
that difference is far too small to move anything.
